issues.explanation: Chapter 112 names the Wu commander who retreats as 孙琳, while Chapter 113 refers to the later ruler and political figure as 孙𬘭. These appear intended to be the same person, but the changed name creates an identity break at the chapter handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Use one consistent name throughout, preferably 孙𬘭, or explicitly indicate that 孙琳 and 孙𬘭 are the same person.
